title: DivergenceMemoryFile
description: Contents of .planning/divergence-memory.json — array of Reflexion entries (BEHAV-03). Written by gsd-debugger post-divergence. Never written by the failed executor.

task_id.description: Matches the plan's task ID exactly (e.g. '28-01-03').

timestamp.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp when the reflection was written.

agent.description: The executor agent that fired the divergence (e.g. 'gsd-executor-backend').

divergence_type.description: Divergence type from the divergence_report. Only these four trigger automatic Reflexion.

what_failed.description: One concrete sentence: what the executor did or failed to do. No hedging vocabulary.

why.description: One concrete sentence: root cause. No hedging vocabulary.

what_to_try_next.description: One concrete sentence: the corrective action for the next attempt.
